frame_bb8fb3731659.question: Vulnerability analysis of Limbo
artifact_refs: reward debt, pending Flan minting, and secondary rewards
crossing bonus eligibility and one-time claim state
token transfer ordering and reentrancy exposure

history.rationale: WHY NOW: Limbo is the core asset and reward custody component, handling user balances, reward issuance, bonus claims, and token transfers; flaws here could directly cause unauthorized minting, loss of staked assets, or accounting insolvency. EXIT CRITERIA: Review all Limbo state transitions and external calls, trace stake/unstake/reward/bonus flows for invariant violations and authorization gaps, assess edge cases such as zero balances, repeated claims, index changes, and transfer failures, and document any concrete vulnerability or conclude that the reviewed invariants hold.

frame_dadfdfdc9faf.question: Vulnerability analysis of RebaseProxy
artifact_refs: reentrancy and failure handling around external token transfers

history.rationale: WHY NOW: RebaseProxy is an unvisited contract controlling conversion between rebasing and base assets, and the graph highlights burn-before-transfer plus rate-based minting. This combination can create critical loss, under-collateralization, authorization, rounding, or denial-of-service issues at an external-token boundary. EXIT CRITERIA: Trace every externally callable path and modifier, identify all state changes and token calls, verify authorization and conversion invariants for redeem/mint flows, assess failure and reentrancy behavior, and document any concrete vulnerability or conclude that no exploitable issue is supported by the static code.
